decisions.statement: The database is read a batch at a time, and each batch becomes rows.
A row carries an id minted when that row is written.
A puzzle nobody has answered is written with no answer.
A run writes the set again, so an answer recorded before is not kept.
A call naming no limit takes the count the ingest holds.
A limit under one refuses the call.
A page is written through the change working out what kind of path it is.
A file the set no longer fills is taken away in the same landing.
The writing the rows go through is handed in.
A run that read before it threw says in its refusal what that run had read.
No test here reaches the puzzle database.

definition: the command streaming the Lichess puzzle database into the rows of a puzzle set
